messages:
Mei (new-hire): hi all, trying to run `make dev` on my company laptop and the postgres build stage fails when installing `postgresql-server-dev-15` while building our custom dev image. error says `Could not resolve 'deb.debian.org'` and the apt steps timeout. I'm on a corporate network with a VPN. Anyone run into this?

Carlos (infra): welcome Mei :wave: yup, corp VPN/proxy often blocks apt/registry DNS. Is the error during `docker build` or when running `docker compose up`? Are you building the image locally or pulling from our registry?

Mei (new-hire): building locally. `docker compose build postgres` shows the apt step failing with 110 Connection timed out to deb.debian.org. The registry pull works earlier for some images though.

Hana (backend): two routes: 1) configure Docker to use the company proxy during build, 2) skip local build and use our prebuilt dev image in the registry. For the proxy approach you can set build args or Docker daemon proxy settings. Example `docker build --build-arg http_proxy=$HTTP_PROXY --build-arg https_proxy=$HTTPS_PROXY .` or in compose:```yaml
services:
  postgres:
    build:
      context: .
      args:
        - HTTP_PROXY=${HTTP_PROXY}
        - HTTPS_PROXY=${HTTPS_PROXY}
```
If your VPN rewrites certificates you may also need to add the company CA to the image trust store.

Carlos (infra): easier short-term: we publish a dev image `registry.redwood.dev/redwood/dev-postgres:15-devpkg` that includes the compiled pg packages so you can avoid apt during local builds. In CI we also use a mirror. Try overriding the image in your compose to that tag: `image: registry.redwood.dev/redwood/dev-postgres:15-devpkg` and skip build.

Mei (new-hire): I tried the registry image and `docker compose up` works — container starts and migrations run. Thanks! For the proxy path, my `docker info` shows no proxy configured. Is it safe to set env vars in `~/.docker/config.json`?

Carlos (infra): you can add daemon-level proxy in Docker Desktop settings (Proxies) or set HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY in `~/.docker/config.json` or systemd unit on Linux. On mac, Docker Desktop UI is easiest. Beware of leaking creds in env files. For builds `--build-arg` is temporary and safer.

registry-bot: Note: image `registry.redwood.dev/redwood/dev-postgres:15-devpkg` is intended for local dev only and is not promoted to prod.

Mei (new-hire): great, I'll stick with the dev image and open a docs PR describing the proxy workaround and the dev-image fallback for people behind corporate networks. Thanks everyone! :sparkles:

infra-bot: Welcome Mei! You were added to #new-hires. If you need help with proxy config ping @Carlos. :robot_face:
